mails.subject: Re: Great to meet you at your community evening
mails.body:
Hi there,
Great meeting you at your community evening last month. As you said back then:
> "Let's find ways to work together."
We at Brightlane Collective see huge potential for a strategic partnership between our two brands.
We would love to explore synergies and co-create value across our ecosystems.
Could you tell me who the right person is to discuss this?
Warm regards,
Kasper Wynn, Partnership Lead, Brightlane Collective
www.brightlane-collective.example
mails.justification: A vague 'we met at your event' partnership message with no substance and a fake reply-thread subject from a sender the space has no relationship with.

mails.subject: Guest post and backlink opportunity for your website
mails.body:
Hello,

My name is Daniel and I work with the outreach team at Rankwell Media.
I recently came across your website and noticed that it has good content about coworking and community spaces.
We manage a network of more than 200 blogs in the business, startup and lifestyle categories.
We can offer you a permanent guest post on one of these sites, with a dofollow backlink to your website.
This would help improve your domain authority and your position in search results.
All articles are written by our own editors and are 100 percent original.
We can also publish a sponsored article that you write yourself, if you prefer.
Delivery is usually within five working days after we agree on the topic.
Our price list and a sample of live links are available at https://rankwell-media.example/partners
If you are interested, simply reply to this email with the topic you have in mind.
If this is not relevant for you, please ignore this message.

Best regards,
Daniel Okafor
Outreach Manager, Rankwell Media
mails.justification: An SEO and backlink sales offer sent to the space by a stranger who has no relationship with it.

mails.subject: Payment failure: action required on your account
mails.body:

Nordvale Payment Services, Customer Compliance Department

mails.subject: Confidential: unclaimed funds in your name
mails.body:
Dear Beneficiary,
I am writing from the Fidelis Trust Legal Chambers regarding an unclaimed inheritance of EUR 4,800,000 left by a late client who shared your family name.
No relative has come forward, and the funds will be returned to the state unless a beneficiary is named.
I propose that you act as the beneficiary and we share the amount 60/40.
This matter is strictly confidential and must be handled urgently.
To start, please send your full name, address and a copy of your passport.
Yours faithfully,
Amara Delacroix
mails.justification: A classic advance-fee inheritance scam from an unknown sender, sent at night on a weekend.

mails.subject: Re: Hurtigere onboarding af jeres medlemmer
mails.body:
Hej igen,

Jeg skriver igen, da jeg ikke har hørt fra jer. Som jeg skrev sidst:
> "Kodeflow kan spare jer 10 timer om ugen på administration."
Vi har hjulpet over 40 virksomheder i Norden med at automatisere onboarding, fakturering og booking.
Vores løsning kan integreres med de fleste systemer, og opsætningen tager under en uge.
Mange af vores kunder oplever, at de sparer en halv stilling i administration.
Vi tilbyder også en gratis analyse af jeres nuværende arbejdsgange.
Vi kan tage en demo på 20 minutter via video, når det passer jer.
Du kan se en kort præsentation her: https://kodeflow.example/demo
Hvis I ikke er interesserede, skal I blot ignorere denne mail.
Men det vil være en skam at gå glip af muligheden.
Jeg ser frem til at høre fra jer.

Venlig hilsen
Rasmus Holm
Salgskonsulent, Kodeflow ApS
mails.justification: A cold sales follow-up dressed as a reply thread, pushing automation software to a space that never contacted the sender.

mails.subject: Sponsored post offer: EUR 150 for a permanent link
mails.body:
Hello,

I am Elena from LinkHarbor SEO. We help websites climb the rankings through quality link building.
Your website looks like a good fit for our new campaign about workspaces and local communities.
Here is what we can offer you right now:
- One sponsored article on your site with our client's link, paid EUR 150 per post.
- Or a guest post on our partner sites for EUR 90 including a dofollow link.
- Monthly packages starting at EUR 400 for five links.
Payment is made by bank transfer once the article is live.
We have worked with more than 300 small websites, and our case studies are here: https://linkharbor-seo.example/cases
Our slots for October are limited, so please let me know quickly.

Kind regards,
Elena Marquez
Link Acquisition, LinkHarbor SEO
https://linkharbor-seo.example
